![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14151148/assets/63789e47ee7a429edd48100456e3c8fdb536a1f67542c27ef687e5e85553f899.png)

For the diagram shown above, which of the following statements are true?

I. The segments $\overset{―}{AB}$ and $\overset{―}{AD}$ are congruent

II. $\overset{―}{AC}≅\overset{―}{BC}$

III. $BE\ne 4\,\text{cm}$
question.worked_solution:
- Statement I is true. According to the picture, we have that both $\overset{―}{AB}$ and $\overset{―}{AD}$ have the same hash marks, so

$$
\overset{―}{AB}≅\overset{―}{AD}.
$$

- Statement II is true. According to the picture, we have that both $\overset{―}{AC}$ and $\overset{―}{BC}$ have the same double hash marks, so

$$
\overset{―}{AC}≅\overset{―}{BC}.
$$

- Statement III is false. From the picture, the two segments $\overset{―}{AB}$ and $\overset{―}{BE}$ have the same hash marks, so 

$$
\overset{―}{AB}≅\overset{―}{BE}.
$$

Hence, $AB=BE=4\,\text{cm}.$

Therefore, only statements I and II are true.
